mechanism.name: Engression official supplementary pre-additive noise: four scenarios, interior conditional medians

generation_equations.label: Source pre-ANM (4)
generation_equations.expression: Y=g(WX+eta)+beta^T X; collected simulation specializes to d=k=1,W=1,beta=0, so Y=g_s(X+eta).

generation_equations.label: Independent noise and rows
generation_equations.expression: eta_i independent of X_i; (X_i,eta_i) iid across i; eta_i~N(0,sigma_s^2), sigma_cubic=1.1, all others=1.

generation_equations.label: Covariate laws
generation_equations.expression: X_i~Unif[-2,2] for softplus,cubic; X_i~Unif[0,2] for square,log.

generation_equations.label: Log, literal table
generation_equations.expression: g_log(u)=(u-2)/3+ln(3) if u<=2; ln(u) if u>2. Literal official supplementary Table C.1, explicitly selected by user; inspected author fixed-snapshot simulator.py line 30 differs.

sampling.dependence: iid across rows; within each row Y is a deterministic nonlinear function of X plus an independent latent Gaussian noise before transformation.
sampling.n_semantics: n is the number of observed training-distribution rows, not the source neural-network training sample size and not the number of conditional draws at the query.

assumptions: Rows (X_i,eta_i) are iid; eta independent of X; all X,Y fully observed; no clustering, panel or network dependence.
The declared original Table C.1 transforms and nontruncated Gaussian laws are fixed. Cubic SD=1.1; other SDs=1.

query_x=0.5 lies strictly inside every original uniform X support, with positive design density. The DGP provides a conditional-CDF version continuous in x near the query; pointwise conditional inference requires local smoothness/design assumptions, not causal exchangeability.
Softplus/cubic are strictly increasing. Square has an atom Phi(-0.5)=0.30853753872598694 at zero for this query, below 0.5; its selected median 1/8 is in the continuous part.

Literal Log is not globally monotone and jumps at u=2, but its selected median ln3-1/2 is below ln2. Locally only the left affine branch contributes, with continuous positive target density 3*phi(0). No current-target CDF kink or out-of-support identification problem is asserted.
The supplement statement median=g(x) is not globally true for literal Log; at x=2, F(g(2);2)=Phi(1). Do not apply the paper global monotone extrapolation theorem blindly to square/log.
No estimator-specific inference theory, interval coverage or named scientific acceptance is established by executable checks.

properties.notes: One observed input X, one active input. Nonlinearity: softplus, positive-part square /2, cubic /3, or printed piecewise log. No cross-covariate interaction: there is only one covariate. Polynomial expansions contain X*eta terms but eta is latent noise, not an observed covariate interaction. Original NN noise dimension 100 is not DGP covariate dimension. Conditional shape/spread varies with X.

estimand.name: q_s(0.5;0.5)
estimand.definition: For each scenario s, q_s(0.5;0.5)=inf{y:F_s(y;0.5)>=0.5}, F_s(y;x)=P_eta[g_s(x+eta)<=y], eta~N(0,sigma_s^2). A scalar conditional median at an interior covariate point; not a marginal quantile, causal effect, prediction interval or simultaneous band.

truth.expression: For each scenario s, q_s(0.5;0.5)=inf{y:F_s(y;0.5)>=0.5}, F_s(y;x)=P_eta[g_s(x+eta)<=y], eta~N(0,sigma_s^2). A scalar conditional median at an interior covariate point; not a marginal quantile, causal effect, prediction interval or simultaneous band.

adaptations: Preserve all four official supplementary Table C.1 transformations, X distributions and Gaussian laws. Use the simulation model Y=g_s(X+eta), corresponding to the published equation (2) and W=1,beta=0 specialization of equation (4).
The current user-authorized target is a single conditional median at interior query_x=0.5,tau=0.5 for each scenario. The query is an Arena scalar adaptation, not a point specified by the paper.
Caller-supplied n, with n=128 for smoke checks, replaces source training sizes 50000/100000. No training or full simulation experiment is reproduced.

The user explicitly selected the literal official supplementary Log formula: ln(u) for u>2. Keep its downward jump; disclose the mismatch with author fixed snapshot eb6b83b1613458b5b3547e4e44a81da4712ab581, simulator.py line 30, ln(1+u). This choice is not author confirmation of a typo or confirmation of the original experiment code.

Use local standard-library RNG and analytic truth with separate CDF inversion, not author PyTorch simulation/evaluation routines. This revision updates provenance only; config and mathematical code remain unchanged from the immediate interior-query baseline. The author simulator defaults are not the Table C.1 scenario settings.
